findings.location: Four reviews form a serial routing loop, first paragraph
findings.problem: The phrase “persistent PM” introduces a key actor without explaining what persists or whether PM means a person, a Codex role, or the Go controller; readers therefore cannot form a precise model of who classifies findings across review attempts.
findings.suggested_direction: Define the PM on first use as the product-manager Codex role and state plainly what continuity “persistent” provides, while keeping the separate validation and routing responsibility of the Go controller explicit.
